== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Dagobah-D-commanderbrandei-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Commander Brandei]]: The game text changes: “any starship” becomes “anything”; “If” becomes “Once during each of your control phases, when”; “once during each of your control phases,” is removed; “search your Reserve Deck and” is removed; “from Reserve Deck; reshuffle” is added after “TIE into hand”; “Shuffle, cut and replace.” is removed. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with the title “•Commander Brandei” and a white italic “E”.

Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2013 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
